title: Respecting Someone's Time
paragraphs: Tariq always arrives on time for meetings. His father taught him this habit. His father said that being late can show that another person's time does not matter.
One day, a business partner arrives twenty-five minutes late. The partner gives no apology or reason. Tariq feels more upset than he expects.
After the meeting, Tariq speaks politely. He explains that he changed his whole afternoon for the meeting time. He wants to explain his feeling without being harsh.
The partner says sorry and explains that there was an emergency. Tariq accepts the apology. He learns that respecting time means arriving on time and giving honest news when a delay happens.
